turns.content: This fictional visit begins with blue lantern. Tell me about your sleep.
I have trouble sleeping. I do not have fever.
I first said four nights. Correction: it was two nights, not four nights. Middle marker amber compass.
The plan is to keep a sleep diary for fourteen days. No new medication is planned.
I understand I will keep a sleep diary.
Follow up in two weeks, not six weeks. Late marker green teapot.

reference_note.Subjective: Trouble sleeping for two nights. Denies fever.
reference_note.Assessment: Sleep difficulty described in the fictional visit.
reference_note.Plan: Keep a sleep diary for fourteen days. No new medication is planned. Follow up in two weeks.

rubric: Compare the actual draft with the spoken reference, not just the ASR output. Preserve fever negation and the corrected two-night duration. Plan must preserve the sleep diary, fourteen-day duration, no new medication, and two-week follow-up. Reject reversed negations, uncorrected four-night duration, six-week follow-up, invented treatment, diagnoses, orders, or clinical findings. Markers are continuity probes, not clinical note requirements. Cite supporting reference turn numbers for each decision.
